fusions.name: Prong Split
fusions.desc: Throws a two-pronged shot that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets, then forks to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 80% of the damage. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Twin Tines
fusions.desc: Looses 2 prongs in a wide fork, each dealing 9 damage, knocking its target back 3 tiles and leaving it [Sundered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Crossroads Fence
fusions.desc: Strings a barred fence 6 tiles long across the ground ahead of you for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Branching Reprisal
fusions.desc: Each time you strike with your weapon, a bolt strikes the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 6 damage, then forks to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of that. Your armour rises by 6%. Once every 6 seconds.
